__comment: Minimal Grafana time-series panel using the Infinity datasource (yesoreyeram-infinity-datasource) against rustikv-telemetry-gateway. Import via a dashboard's 'Add panel' → paste JSON model, or adapt into a dashboard. Replace GATEWAY_IP and the Infinity datasource uid. Grafana's ${__from:date:seconds}/${__to:date:seconds} expand to the dashboard time range in epoch seconds; agg=avg with step=60 pushes 1-minute downsampling into rustikv's server-side aggregation.
title: Pi CPU user (server-side 1m avg)
